header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there, and its line saying so is the one
waited for), Start Game, the intro, Start to the file select and A on Game 1, which on a new profile starts a new
game. Its opening is skipped to Spiral Mountain as Start skips it once a save exists, and Mumbo's Mountain is reached
after it by tools/warp.js, the request the game's own code leaves for a map change, each a need that fails the run
unless the map asked for is the one playing. In each Banjo walks to and fro, a little further out than back (the
house's door is behind him in Spiral Mountain), jumps, attacks and turns the camera, about 25 s, with a shot about 8 s
in. Its waits and holds there are on the game's own clock, the seconds it adds each frame's length to (the struct at
0x8037E8E0's +8, read in 60ths), so every browser walks Banjo as far whatever frames it gives the game; the last step
reads where Banjo is (player_position). tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to three more places, for when a longer
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: (() => { const f = (a) => new Float32Array(new Uint32Array([n64r(a)]).buffer)[0]; return [0, 4, 8].map((i) => Math.round(f(0x8037C5A0 + i))); })()
